episodes.title: Millennium Approaches: Chapter One - Bad News
episodes.summary: A powerful lawyer receives difficult news from his doctor; a Mormon couple adjusts to life in New York City; a scion of a wealthy family copes with an illness.

episodes.title: Millennium Approaches: Chapter Two - In Vitro
episodes.summary: A man struggles with his partner's illness; a distraught Mormon housewife copes with her husband's strange behavior.

episodes.title: Millennium Approaches: Chapter Three - The Messenger
episodes.summary: A Mormon couple reach a crossroads in their marriage; a lawyer encounters a face from his past; a patient is warned of an impending arrival.

episodes.title: Perestroika: Chapter Four - Stop Moving!
episodes.summary: Prior is confused by his fantastic encounter with an angel; Joe feels liberated by a new relationship; Roy Cohn is hospitalized as his condition worsens.

episodes.title: Perestroika: Chapter Five - Beyond Nelly
episodes.summary: Roy pulls strings to obtain an extremely rare prescription; Louis is overcome with guilt for leaving his lover; Hannah befriends Prior in his time of need.

episodes.title: Perestroika: Chapter Six - Heaven, I'm in Heaven
episodes.summary: Belize seizes an opportunity to help others in need; Harper makes a decision about her future; Prior fights for his life at the gates of heaven.
